verdict.rationale: Skills can be used without an interactive UI in several documented ways. The Messages API takes up to 20 skills per request via the `container` parameter, managed through the Skills API (docs-10, docs-23, docs-24). The Agent SDK lets code control and load skills and plugins (docs-63, docs-78, docs-77). Claude Code supports non-interactive `claude -p` piping (docs-83). A recorded probe also installed a skill non-interactively with `npx skills add ... -y`, with no account needed (probe-rt-1). Missing for 10: an explicit CI integration guide (e.g., a GitHub Actions recipe for skills), and hands-on evidence of a skill actually executing headlessly in a CI pipeline.
